meta.title: Bloom - Grow beautifully
meta.description: Bloom is a personal growth garden. Every meaningful effort plants a seed. Every focused hour helps your garden bloom.

about.title: Bloom
about.description: Bloom is a gamified productivity app that turns focused work into visible progress, sustainable habits, and personal growth.
about.whyIntro: Bloom is designed to help you:
about.why5: See what your focused time is worth
about.philosophyBody: Small actions compound into extraordinary results. Bloom encourages consistency rather than perfection.
about.visionBody: Transform focused work into visible progress, meaningful achievements, and a supportive community.
about.statusBody: We are continuously improving the product based on real user feedback.

onboarding.step2Question: How much is one focused hour worth to you?
onboarding.step2Hint: Bloom uses this to work out how much each task earns: a 30-minute step earns half of it. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.intro: Finish tasks, see what your focused time is worth, and grow a garden along the way.
onboarding.customValueError: Enter an amount of at least 1,000₫.
onboarding.step3Hint: Pick any that fit. Your daily quotes will match them.
onboarding.step4Hint: The app changes as you pick.

home.gardenEmpty: Write a journal entry at the end of the day to plant your first flower.
home.balanceNote: What your focused time and finished tasks are worth. Not real money.
home.quietNotice: It has been quiet for a while. Your garden rested and is waiting for you.
home.heroDone: Every step is done. Nice work!

momentum.title: How your balance works
momentum.ruleStep: Finish a step: earn its time × your hourly value ({amount} per hour).
momentum.ruleStreak: Keep your streak going to day 2 and beyond: +{amount} a day.
momentum.ruleFullDay: Finish every step, then write your journal: +{amount} bonus.
momentum.ruleLostStreak: Lose a streak after a missed day: -{amount}, once. Some flowers wilt, then bloom again as you finish steps.
momentum.ruleLate: A task more than 3 days past its deadline: -{amount}, once per task.
momentum.ruleRefund: Unticking a step takes back what it earned. Your balance never drops below 0.
momentum.ruleMath: Why it matters: 1% better every day is about 37× in a year (1.01^365 ≈ 37.78).

install.title: Use Bloom as an app
install.body: Add Bloom to your home screen: it opens full screen, works offline, and costs nothing. No app store needed.
install.iosStep1: In Safari, tap the Share button
install.iosStep3: Tap Add. Bloom now opens like any app.
install.androidStep2: Choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”
install.desktopStep1: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar
install.desktopStep2: On your phone, open this site in Safari or Chrome and add it to the home screen

tutorial.addBody: Type one thing you want to finish today, then press Add task.
tutorial.tickBody: Tap the step to mark it done. You will see the money it earned. Try it now.
tutorial.balanceBody: Every finished step adds its time × your hourly value. It is not real money, just what your focus is worth.
tutorial.dashboardBody: The Dashboard shows your money, focus time, streak and garden.
tutorial.journalTitle: End the day with a note
tutorial.journalBody: After you finish a step, write a note on Today to plant flowers. Past notes live here in Journal.
